description.desc_thousand_char: Triveni Polymers Private Limited (TPPL), as per its annual filings, is engaged in the business of manufacturing solid and liquid bottles and ophthalmic and parenteral applications. The company offers a range of 'Triveni' branded US-type containers and 'Duma' branded solid containers in HDPE and caps in LDPE and PP for the pharmaceutical market. TPPL has offices/factory/units in Delhi, Kundli (Haryana), Kosamba (Gujarat), and Hyderabad in India. The company was incorporated in 1994 and has its registered office located in Delhi.
